response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), totals AS (SELECT SUM(tally) as total_tally, COUNT(*) as status_count FROM status_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT sc.archstat, sc.tally, CAST(sc.tally AS REAL) / t.total_tally as share, CAST(1 AS REAL) / t.status_count as avg_share FROM status_counts sc, totals t), final_results AS (SELECT archstat, tally, share, share - avg_share as above_average FROM with_shares WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT archstat, tally, share, above_average FROM final_results
